section.name: Overview
section.p: Contributions are always welcome. The preferred way to contribute is by opening a pull request against our GitHub repository. Remember that pull requests for documentation, code samples, or additional test cases are just as valuable as core functionality changes.

section.name: Rules for Submitting Pull Requests
section.p: These rules are intended to minimize the effort maintainers must spend when reviewing and merging a pull request. If a pull request requires significant cleanup before merging, it may be closed or requested to be refactored. Everyone on this project volunteers their time, so please be considerate.

ul.li: Make sure your code follows our coding conventions. We use Checkstyle to automatically enforce code formatting during the Maven build.

Ensure new code includes automated unit tests written with JUnit. No pull request with code changes will be merged without corresponding unit tests. Whenever possible, test classes should extend WebDriverTestCase.
If you are fixing a bug, please include a test case that fails with the previous behavior.
All existing unit tests must pass prior to submitting your pull request.
All files must carry the Gargoyle Software Inc. copyright notice and be licensed under the project's Apache License 2.0.
All non-private methods must include clear JavaDoc documentation. When editing a file, add an @author tag at the top in chronological order.

section.p: IMPORTANT: Pull requests without tests will be rejected[cite: 11]. If you are unsure how to write a test for a specific scenario, ask for guidance in your pull request description or on the developer mailing list.
Additional documentation updates and example improvements are always greatly appreciated.
